title: gaze, voice-level, timed quiet, no reflex narration

claims.text: Nova now performs asked-for gaze actions (look toward sound, look toward face, lock on a face until released, release), raises or lowers its voice on request, can stay quiet for a set number of minutes and resume on its own, and no longer narrates its own reflexes unless asked — and the cold-boot Kiro degraded-start path has been exercised live

honesty_conditions.text: Every item in the announcement is demonstrable on the robot (not only in unit tests) and each maps to at least one confirmed requirement on this frame

claims.text: Today every body reflex reaching the mind is voiced back: config/nervous-system/rules.yaml:236-242 renders the generic rule/fire template "Your body just reacted on its own — the '{rule}' reflex fired." and the harness system prompt (reachy_nova/harness/app.py:52-64) tells Sonic to 'mention what you did in a few words' with no instruction against describing mechanism

honesty_conditions.text: The pre-change journal from 2026-08-26 (or a fresh pat on the unpatched build) shows the 'reflex fired' inject text — the before-state is evidenced, not remembered

claims.text: Reflex injects become quiet context, not prompts: rewrite rules.yaml inject templates for rule/fire, rule/fire:pat-acknowledge, rule/fire:nova-face-noticed and pat/* as parenthetical situational awareness with no 'reflex'/'rule'/'reacted on its own' wording, and add a system-prompt line in HARNESS_SYSTEM_PROMPT that Nova reacts naturally to body cues and never describes its own mechanism unless asked

honesty_conditions.text: After the change, grep of every rendered inject for the pat, face-noticed and generic rule/fire entries contains none of: 'reflex', 'rule', 'reacted on its own', 'leaning', 'antenna' — pinned by a test over rules.yaml rendering

claims.text: Per-rule voice policy in rules.yaml (a 'voice: silent|brief|free' field, or reuse of urgency) with body reflexes defaulting to silent/brief; rendered into the inject text as an explicit marker Sonic can obey; pinned by tests on rules.yaml rendering

honesty_conditions.text: load_rules/rule_for accept a 'voice' field with default 'free'; a test asserts generic rule/fire is 'silent' and that a silent rule still produces an inject (never dropped) carrying the marker

claims.text: The ~8 s duplicate pat inject is two runtime rules firing on one touch — the shipped 'pat-acknowledge' (default_rules.toml:69) and the Kiro-authored overlay 'nova-pat-cheer' — each crossing the bus as its own rule/fire and each rendering an inject; Sonic's global 3 s inject throttle cannot catch an 8 s gap

One inject per sense class per cooldown: a sense-class dedupe in NovaBus between route_event and _on_inject (bus.py:574-593) so pat-acknowledge, nova-pat-cheer and any future pat/* topic collapse into one inject within the window

honesty_conditions.text: A test feeds two rule/fire events (pat-acknowledge then nova-pat-cheer) within the cooldown window and asserts exactly one inject reaches Sonic; a pat after the window produces a fresh inject

claims.text: 'Why did you do that?' is answerable: keep a small recent-sense ring buffer (last N routed injects with timestamps) next to NovaBus._on_inject or CognitionFeed and expose it to Sonic on request (an inject or a tool), so the answer references the actual last sense event

honesty_conditions.text: A test injects three routed senses then asks for recent history and gets them in order with timestamps; the live answer to 'why did you move?' names the actual last sense

claims.text: The harness gains no motion code for any gaze action: look-toward-sound, look-toward-face and face-lock/release are runtime-side (reachy-mini-cli) behaviors/intents, requested from the harness through the intents spool; the AST boundary test (no reachy_mini import, no set_target) stays green

honesty_conditions.text: tests/test_harness_boundary.py stays green after all gaze work: no reachy_mini import and no set_target reference anywhere under reachy_nova/harness/

claims.text: look-toward-sound (#13) is a new one-shot LibraryEntry in reachy-mini-cli library.py modelled on gaze-hold (default_duration, StopClass.STOPPABLE, _HEAD channels) that reuses orient.py's DoA-to-yaw path for a single aim; the harness run_behavior tool forwards any name unchanged, so #13/#14 need no harness schema change — only tool-description/prompt text and a rules.yaml inject entry for the result

Refuse look-toward-sound with a named reason when no recent DoA exists: DoaPoller must expose the age of its last good reading (Sense carries no timestamp by design), and the behavior refuses above a staleness threshold (candidate: orient.py's latch_after_s=8 s)

honesty_conditions.text: With no DoA reading (or one older than the staleness threshold) run_behavior look-toward-sound returns {ok:false, error:<named reason>} and no head motion; with a fresh reading the head turns within the behavior's yaw clamp
